title: Constructibility of finite-cover lower-shriek coefficients
statement: With the hypotheses of v1-finite-cover-lower-shriek-coefficient-compatibility, the sheaf K = j_!(v_*v^*G) is constructible.

source.place: Tag 03SD, lemma-vanishing-easier, first paragraph (coefficient check implicit in descent to a summand); Tag 095R, lemma-finite-pushforward-constructible, and its finite etale case lemma-pushforward-constructible.

proof.text: Pullback preserves finite locally constant sheaves; finite etale lower-star preserves finite local constancy; finite local constancy gives constructibility, and extension by zero along an open immersion preserves constructibility.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03SD, first paragraph; coefficient check written out from stalk annihilation and Bezout; constructibility follows the finite-etale local trivialization proof in lemma-pushforward-constructible.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCoverLowerShriek_constructible_pending {k : Type u}
    [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X U V : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] [IsReduced X]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime]
    (G : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))))
    [Scheme.IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf G] (v : V ⟶ U) [IsFinite v] [Etale v] :
    Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf
      ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) j).obj
        ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) v).obj
          ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) v).obj G)))
